info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Customer Relationship-spec
info.description: The Customer Relationship Management API facilitates the establishment of relationships for banking customers. This endpoint allows businesses to create new relationships for a specified customer, enhancing engagement and service delivery. Common use cases include linking customer accounts, managing partnerships, and establishing contractual relationships. Financial institutions and service providers can utilize this API to streamline customer relationship processes and enhance customer retention.

post.summary: Create a relationship for a specific customer.
post.description: This operation allows you to establish a new relationship for the customer identified by the given ID. Provide the necessary relationship details in the request body to successfully link this customer with the desired entity.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create or update relationships for the customer with ID CUST-100045. It contains the necessary data required to establish the relationship as defined by the schema.
